question: For which country did the former cricketer Roger Binny play cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Roger Binny is a former Indian cricketer who represented **India** in international cricket.
 
• He was a part of the Indian team that won the **1983 Cricket World Cup**, making significant contributions as an all-rounder.
 
• Binny was the leading wicket-taker in the **1983 Cricket World Cup**, securing 18 wickets during the tournament.
 
• He primarily played as a **bowling all-rounder** and contributed both with the bat and ball in international matches.
 
• Roger Binny played domestic cricket for Karnataka and was known for his medium-pace bowling and effective batting skills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1983 Cricket World Cup:**

 
 
• India defeated the West Indies in the final, marking its first-ever World Cup victory.
 
• The win is considered a landmark achievement in Indian cricket history.
 
• Kapil Dev was the captain of the Indian team during the tournament.
 
 
 
• **Bowling All-rounder:**
 
 
• A cricket player who contributes significantly with both the ball and bat.
 
• Roger Binny excelled in this role, providing crucial wickets and runs for India.
 
 
 
• **Domestic Career:**
 
 
• Roger Binny represented Karnataka in domestic cricket.
 
• He played in the Ranji Trophy, India's premier domestic cricket tournament.
 
 
 
• **Post-retirement:**
 
 
• Roger Binny has been involved in cricket administration, serving as a selector for the Indian cricket team.
 
• He has contributed to the development of Indian cricket through various roles after his playing career.
